title: Over 100 crude bomb blasts, vehicle arson rock Bangladesh amid fresh wave of violence

ai.summary: Bangladesh reported over 100 crude bomb explosions and vehicle arson attacks across multiple districts, killing one person and causing widespread panic and road blockades.

facts.quote: Dhaka, Nov 11: Bangladesh witnessed a fresh surge of violence, with over 100 crude bomb explosions, vehicle arson attacks and violent demonstrations erupting across several districts, leaving one person dead, local media reported on Wednesday.

facts.claim: at least eight vehicles set ablaze
facts.quote: As violence spread across several districts, with explosions, clashes and road blockades reported in Dhaka, Shariatpur, Gopalganj, Chittagong and Manikganj, at least eight vehicles were set ablaze between early Tuesday and evening.
Police Headquarters recorded that 22 vehicles were set ablaze nationwide in the 24-hour period ending Tuesday morning.
